_about: Known-good oracle for the Connes-van Suijlekom Galerkin matrix Q(c). connes-cvs is used as a forward cross-check / dev-dependency only; we never fit to it. Regenerate with scripts/run_connes_cvs_oracle.py --write.

normalization_note.what: lambda_min is connes-cvs's internal ground-state eigenvalue. The CCM/Connes papers tabulate the *zero error* |gamma_k - t_k|, not lambda_min. The ~1.2-1.3 factor below relates connes-cvs's first-zero error to the published values; it reflects N/T/precision and normalization conventions, not a correctness gap. Interpret absolute lambda_min with this in mind.
